item.title: Joy As An Act Of Resistance: Manjeet Sarkar On Power, Privilege, & "Internet Gangsters"
item.description: Joy As An Act Of Resistance: Manjeet Sarkar On Power, Privilege, & 'Internet Gangsters' Watching Manjeet bloom over the years as a creative has been a real treat. Especially amidst the anxieties around creative work today, where everything has to justify itself in numbers — views, reach, ticket sales, and marketability.

item.title: ‘Amputate The Fake’: Shilpa Ananth's New Single Is A Declaration Of Radical Authenticity
item.description: 'Amputate The Fake': Shilpa Ananth’s Tamil-Soul & RnB Track Is A Call To Awaken The Real Deep bass grooves, layered harmonies, and Tona’s soulful flugelhorn riffs anchor a soundscape that moves between soul, R&B, jazz, and hip-hop.

item.title: Secrets Of The Sweet Shop: How Sameer Seth & Yash Bhanage Built A Culinary Empire Of Joy
item.description: Secrets Of The Sweet Shop: How Sameer Seth & Yash Bhanage Built A Culinary Empire Of Joy Hunger Inc.'s ‘allergic to bullshit’, laser-focused, context-driven and thoughtful approach has allowed them to transform the notion of what elevated Indian cuisine and hospitality can and should look like.

item.description: What Happens When We Lose The Skills That Taught Us How To Be Present? What happens to human judgment, attention, and fine motor skills in an automated world? A deep dive on the disappearing skills that once shaped how we lived in the world.

item.title: Badluram Ka Badan: The History Behind The Assam Regiment's Iconic Company Song
item.description: Badluram Ka Badan: The Story Behind Assam Regiment's Iconic Regimental Song In 1946, Major M.T. Proktor wrote and composed the song 'Badluram Ka Badan' in honour of Badluram — an Indian soldier who died during the Battle of Kohima in 1944.
